_about: HOLD-OUT scenarios written by the Verifier in iteration 2, never shown to the Modernizer. Derived by hand from the ORIGINAL HyperTalk in output/hypercard/<stack>/ir/ir.json, deliberately targeting handlers and branches the main scenarios.json does not exercise. Run: node eval/behave.mjs hypercard <sample> --holdout (writes eval/hypercard/behave_holdout/). Game Genie expected codes: eval/hypercard/gamegenie_sim.py logic extended with 'to num 8'.
